title: ApiError
description: Error body of every S1 API route (OQ-04 section 12). It states what failed, whether state changed, whether a retry is safe and a diagnostic reference. state_changed NONE is used only when the API has authoritative evidence that nothing changed. It never carries credentials, stack traces or full payloads. violations is absent when there is none, never empty, so every valid body has one canonical form. It carries the listing of the contract layer unchanged (OQ-05 section 7): at most 21 entries, the first 20 violations and, when there are more, one last entry with an empty pointer whose message counts the rest. The API cuts a pointer or a message longer than the maximum of its field to that many characters, and never sends an invalid error body.

ApiViolation.title: ApiViolation
ApiViolation.description: One contract violation: a JSON Pointer into the request body and a bounded message. The pointer of the entry that counts the omitted violations is empty.
